services.title: Residential Fencing
services.text: We offer a wide range of residential fencing solutions to meet your needs, from privacy fences to decorative picket fences. Our team will work with you to design and install a fence that complements your property and enhances your outdoor living space.

services.title: Commercial Fencing

services.title: Free Consultation

about.title: Building strong fences. Building lasting relationships.
text: At Southern Texas Fence (STF), we take pride in providing high-quality fencing solutions for homeowners and businesses throughout the Greater Houston area. Our mission is simple: deliver exceptional craftsmanship, honest pricing, and customer service you can depend on from the first phone call to the final walkthrough.

Whether you're looking for added privacy, improved security, or a beautiful new fence to enhance your property's curb appeal, our experienced team has the knowledge and skills to get the job done right. Every project is built using quality materials and proven installation techniques to ensure long-lasting durability.

At STF, we believe that every customer deserves reliable service, clear communication, and a fence built to last. No matter the size of your project, we're committed to exceeding your expectations with professional workmanship and attention to detail.
